title: Inverse frequency reindexing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $J$ be a finite set of elements of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $S$ be a subset of $J$. Reindex $S$ by the increasing bijection from $J$ to $\{0,\ldots,|J|-1\}$, then map the resulting subset back along the inverse bijection; the result is $S$.
